mapper.select: WITH family_line_source AS ( SELECT line_id, MAX(family_id) AS family_id FROM FAMILY_LINE GROUP BY line_id ), usage_source AS ( SELECT d.usage_date AS usage_date, d.line_id AS line_id, fl.family_id AS family_id, d.application_id AS application_id, d.individual_usage_data AS individual_usage, d.shared_usage_data AS shared_usage, d.qos_usage_data AS qos_usage FROM DAILY_APP_TOTAL_DATA d LEFT JOIN family_line_source fl ON fl.line_id = d.line_id WHERE d.usage_date = #{usageDate} AND d.line_id >= #{lineIdStartInclusive} AND d.line_id <= #{lineIdEndInclusive} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT DATE(t.enqueued_at) AS usage_date, t.line_id AS line_id, t.family_id AS family_id, t.app_id AS application_id, t.deducted_individual_bytes AS individual_usage, t.deducted_shared_bytes AS shared_usage, t.deducted_qos_bytes AS qos_usage FROM TRAFFIC_DEDUCT_DONE t WHERE t.enqueued_at >= #{dayStartInclusive} AND t.enqueued_at < #{dayEndExclusive} AND t.line_id >= #{lineIdStartInclusive} AND t.line_id <= #{lineIdEndInclusive} ) SELECT 'DAILY_TOTAL_USAGE' AS key_type, line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, usage_date AS usage_date, NULL AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, '__value__' AS field_name, SUM(individual_usage + shared_usage + qos_usage) AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM usage_source GROUP BY line_id, usage_date HAVING SUM(individual_usage + shared_usage + qos_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY_APP_USAGE', line_id, NULL, NULL, usage_date, NULL, application_id, CONCAT('app:', application_id, ':individual'), SUM(individual_usage), 0 FROM usage_source GROUP BY line_id, usage_date, application_id HAVING SUM(individual_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY_APP_USAGE', line_id, NULL, NULL, usage_date, NULL, application_id, CONCAT('app:', application_id, ':shared'), SUM(shared_usage), 0 FROM usage_source GROUP BY line_id, usage_date, application_id HAVING SUM(shared_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY_APP_USAGE', line_id, NULL, NULL, usage_date, NULL, application_id, CONCAT('app:', application_id, ':qos'), SUM(qos_usage), 0 FROM usage_source GROUP BY line_id, usage_date, application_id HAVING SUM(qos_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY_SHARED_USAGE' AS key_type, line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, usage_date AS usage_date, NULL AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'usage_amount' AS field_name, SUM(shared_usage) AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM usage_source WHERE family_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY line_id, usage_date HAVING SUM(shared_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'DAILY_SHARED_USAGE' AS key_type, line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, usage_date AS usage_date, NULL AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'family_id' AS field_name, MAX(family_id) AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM usage_source WHERE family_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY line_id, usage_date HAVING SUM(shared_usage) > 0

WITH family_line_source AS ( SELECT line_id, MAX(family_id) AS family_id FROM FAMILY_LINE GROUP BY line_id ), usage_source AS ( SELECT d.usage_date AS usage_date, d.line_id AS line_id, fl.family_id AS family_id, d.individual_usage_data AS individual_usage, d.shared_usage_data AS shared_usage FROM DAILY_APP_TOTAL_DATA d LEFT JOIN family_line_source fl ON fl.line_id = d.line_id WHERE d.usage_date >= #{startInclusive} AND d.usage_date < #{endExclusive} AND d.line_id >= #{lineIdStartInclusive} AND d.line_id <= #{lineIdEndInclusive} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT DATE(t.enqueued_at) AS usage_date, t.line_id AS line_id, t.family_id AS family_id, t.deducted_individual_bytes AS individual_usage, t.deducted_shared_bytes AS shared_usage FROM TRAFFIC_DEDUCT_DONE t WHERE t.enqueued_at >= #{startDateTimeInclusive} AND t.enqueued_at < #{endDateTimeExclusive} AND t.line_id >= #{lineIdStartInclusive} AND t.line_id <= #{lineIdEndInclusive} ), line_month_usage AS ( SELECT line_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(individual_usage) AS individual_usage FROM usage_source GROUP BY line_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ), family_month_usage AS ( SELECT family_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start, SUM(shared_usage) AS shared_usage FROM usage_source WHERE family_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY family_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) ) SELECT 'REMAINING_INDIVIDUAL' AS key_type, u.line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, NULL AS usage_date, u.month_start AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'amount' AS field_name, l.total_data - u.individual_usage AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM line_month_usage u JOIN LINE l ON l.line_id = u.line_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'REMAINING_INDIVIDUAL', u.line_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, u.month_start, NULL, 'qos', CASE WHEN p.qos_speed_limit IS NULL OR p.qos_speed_limit < 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.qos_speed_limit * 125 END, 0 FROM line_month_usage u JOIN LINE l ON l.line_id = u.line_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN PLAN p ON p.plan_id = l.plan_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'REMAINING_SHARED', NULL, u.family_id, NULL, NULL, u.month_start, NULL, 'amount', f.pool_total_data - u.shared_usage, 0 FROM family_month_usage u JOIN FAMILY f ON f.family_id = u.family_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'MONTHLY_SHARED_USAGE' AS key_type, line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, NULL AS usage_date, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'usage_amount' AS field_name, SUM(shared_usage) AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM usage_source WHERE family_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY line_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) HAVING SUM(shared_usage) > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'MONTHLY_SHARED_USAGE' AS key_type, line_id AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, NULL AS policy_id, NULL AS usage_date, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'family_id' AS field_name, MAX(family_id) AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM usage_source WHERE family_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY line_id, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(usage_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) HAVING SUM(shared_usage) > 0

SELECT 'POLICY' AS key_type, NULL AS line_id, NULL AS family_id, policy_id AS policy_id, NULL AS usage_date, NULL AS month_start, NULL AS application_id, 'value' AS field_name, CASE WHEN is_active = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS expected_value, 0 AS expire_epoch_seconds FROM POLICY
